appointment_series_position.name: appointment_series_position
appointment_series_position.value: ("appointments"."seriesId" is null and "appointments"."occurrenceIndex" is null) or ("appointments"."seriesId" is not null and "appointments"."occurrenceIndex" is not null and "appointments"."occurrenceIndex" between 0 and 52)

paused_task_has_routine.name: paused_task_has_routine
paused_task_has_routine.value: "daily_tasks"."pausedBy" is null or "daily_tasks"."templateId" is not null

pair_code_child_scope.name: pair_code_child_scope
pair_code_child_scope.value: ("device_pairing_codes"."kind" = 'android' and "device_pairing_codes"."childId" is not null) or ("device_pairing_codes"."kind" = 'wall' and "device_pairing_codes"."childId" is null)

device_child_scope.name: device_child_scope
device_child_scope.value: ("devices"."kind" = 'android' and "devices"."childId" is not null) or ("devices"."kind" = 'wall' and "devices"."childId" is null)

journal_entry_kind.name: journal_entry_kind
journal_entry_kind.value:
("point_entries"."taskId" is not null and "point_entries"."expenseKey" is null and "point_entries"."correctionOf" is null and "point_entries"."correctedBy" is null and "point_entries"."correctionReason" is null and "point_entries"."amount" between 0 and 1000)
    or ("point_entries"."taskId" is null and "point_entries"."expenseKey" is not null and "point_entries"."correctionOf" is null and "point_entries"."correctedBy" is null and "point_entries"."correctionReason" is null and "point_entries"."amount" < 0)
    or ("point_entries"."taskId" is null and "point_entries"."expenseKey" is null and "point_entries"."correctionOf" is not null and "point_entries"."correctionOf" <> "point_entries"."id" and "point_entries"."correctedBy" is not null and "point_entries"."correctionReason" is not null and length(trim("point_entries"."correctionReason")) between 1 and 1000 and "point_entries"."amount" between -1000 and 0)

request_decision.name: request_decision
request_decision.value: ("reward_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "reward_requests"."decidedAt" is null and "reward_requests"."decidedBy" is null) or ("reward_requests"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected') and "reward_requests"."decidedAt" is not null and "reward_requests"."decidedBy" is not null)
